message: As a parent, I often find myself caught in the whirlwind of kids’ activities and daily chaos, so it’s easy to forget the importance of being prepared for unexpected moments. This resource offers some great safety skills that I believe can help us all feel a little more at ease when juggling the responsibilities of family life. It’s all about creating a calm environment for our kids, where they feel secure and informed. What’s one tip you’ve found helpful for teaching your little ones about safety?
